title: The Bog Light
text: A light bobs over the marsh, always just ahead, soft and blue as a candle behind a curtain. It waits when you stop. It goes the way you were going anyway, which is either very kind of it or not kind at all.

options.label: Follow the blue light, and trust it knows the way through.

outcomes.text: It leads you through the marsh by a dry path no map shows, then winks out at the end, satisfied.
It leads you into the deep water. There it waits, watching to see who comes to watch you drown.

options.label: The quickest tries to catch it in a jar, before it can lead anyone astray.

outcomes.text: It beats against the glass of the jar, very angry and very bright.
The jar is empty. The light is behind them, very close, then gone; they cannot stop shaking.

options.label: Keep to your own way, and ignore its soft invitation.

outcomes.text: It sulks off over the water. The mist it leaves behind is the kind that settles in the lungs.
